data.description: RED task. When rebase_retry returns kind='reject_and_reschedule': emit health event {kind: reject_and_reschedule, attempt_count, last_error}, exit with reschedule exit code (non-zero, distinct from drift-abort). No partial state persisted across pass boundary — next pass starts fresh. E2E test: run pass N (forced reject_and_reschedule) then pass N+1 (contention removed), assert N+1 succeeds with no residual state. Assert no retry-counter file written to disk.
data.title: Implement reject-and-reschedule exit path after 3 failed write attempts
